subject.title: [Bug]: Session transcript mirroring writes header cwd from process.cwd(), allowing cross-agent workspace contamination

question: Should maintainers repair or replace the open linked fix PR, or intentionally defer this transcript cwd isolation bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and security/session-state sensitive, but an external open closing PR already owns the same path, so ClawSweeper should not open a parallel fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair or Replace the Open Fix PR
options.body: Rebase or adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50454, or close it after opening a narrow replacement that resolves the target workspace before header creation.

options.title: Defer but Keep Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical bug if maintainers want broader cwd/workspace cleanup before changing transcript headers.

options.title: Accept Existing Behavior
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the remaining ordinary mirror fallback is acceptable despite the source and production evidence.

recommendation.title: Repair or Replace the Open Fix PR
recommendation.body: Rebase or adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50454, or close it after opening a narrow replacement that resolves the target workspace before header creation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the delivery mirroring path and has the strongest recent current-main history on the transcript append code.
